-- Таблиця Client
CREATE TABLE Client (

-- Таблиця Employee
CREATE TABLE Employee (

    Name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    Position VARCHAR(50),
    PRIMARY KEY (Employee_ID)
) ENGINE = InnoDB;

-- Таблиця Service
CREATE TABLE Service (
    Service_ID INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    Name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    Price DECIMAL(10,2),
    PRIMARY KEY (Service_ID)
) ENGINE = InnoDB;

-- Таблиця Payment
CREATE TABLE Payment (
    Payment_ID INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    Amount DECIMAL(10,2),
    Payment_Method ENUM('готівка', 'картка'),
    PRIMARY KEY (Payment_ID)
) ENGINE = InnoDB;

-- Таблиця ClientOrder
CREATE TABLE ClientOrder (
    Order_ID INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    Client_ID INT NOT NULL,
    Employee_ID INT NOT NULL,
    Payment_ID INT NOT NULL,
    Order_Date DATETIME,
    Status ENUM('виконано', 'очікує', 'скасовано'),
    PRIMARY KEY (Order_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Client_ID) REFERENCES Client(Client_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Employee_ID) REFERENCES Employee(Employee_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Payment_ID) REFERENCES Payment(Payment_ID)
) ENGINE = InnoDB;

-- Таблиця Order_Services
CREATE TABLE Order_Services (

    FOREIGN KEY (Service_ID) REFERENCES Service(Service_ID)
) ENGINE = InnoDB;

SELECT * FROM Client;

SELECT * FROM Employee;

SELECT * FROM Service;

SELECT * FROM Payment;

SELECT * FROM ClientOrder;

SELECT * FROM Order_Services;

SELECT DISTINCT c.* 
FROM Client c
JOIN ClientOrder o ON c.Client_ID = o.Client_ID;

SELECT o.Order_ID, c.Name, o.Order_Date, o.Status
FROM ClientOrder o
JOIN Client c ON o.Client_ID = c.Client_ID;

SELECT e.Name, COUNT(o.Order_ID) AS Order_Count
FROM Employee e
JOIN ClientOrder o ON e.Employee_ID = o.Employee_ID
GROUP BY e.Employee_ID;

SELECT s.Name, COUNT(os.Order_ID) AS Order_Count
FROM Service s
JOIN Order_Services os ON s.Service_ID = os.Service_ID
GROUP BY s.Service_ID
HAVING COUNT(os.Order_ID) > 1;

SELECT Payment_ID, Amount, Payment_Method FROM Payment;

SELECT * FROM ClientOrder WHERE Status = 'виконано';

SELECT * FROM ClientOrder
ORDER BY Order_Date DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT * FROM Client
WHERE Email IS NULL OR Email = '';

SELECT os.Order_ID, SUM(os.Quantity) AS Total_Services
FROM Order_Services os
GROUP BY os.Order_ID;
